blocks.text: Thumbs Up / Thumbs Down is simple, quick and silent. Ask the class a question, and each student answers with just one thumb.
Ask, “How was your commute this morning?”

items: Thumb in the middle: “It was… fine.”

blocks.text: add some drama! Have students act out how they feel with their thumb: a slow, sad thumbs down with a sigh, or a big, proud thumbs up held high.

It takes seconds, needs no materials and every student can answer, including those who aren’t ready to speak. Teachers get an instant read of the room. It’s a great way to open a lesson, check in on feelings, or ease into bigger drama strategies like Position Mapping.
